name: Full Players Count For Drops
description: Removes the party-averaging that halves the effective player count used for Treasure Class NoDrop scaling. Vanilla computes nPlayerCount = (playerCount - partyMembers) / 2 + partyMembers inside the TC walker sub_1404404F0, so a solo character on /players 8 is scaled as 4 players. NOPing the single 'sar eax,1' leaves (playerCount - partyMembers) + partyMembers = playerCount, so the setting applies at face value. Party play is unaffected: when partyMembers equals playerCount the averaging was already a no-op.

patches.description: sub_1404404F0 +0x5AC: NOP the 'sar eax,1' that halves (playerCount - partyMembers) before partyMembers is added back. Original 2 bytes D1 F8. The preceding cdq / sub eax,edx rounding fixup is deliberately left intact so EDX behaviour downstream is byte-for-byte unchanged.
